# LifePilot feature discovery

Turn an initial idea into a small, testable product brief without assuming implementation details.

## Procedure

1. Read the [product vision](../../../docs/PRODUCT_VISION.md) and inspect relevant existing documentation and product behavior.
2. Restate the user's goal and identify which LifePilot capability area it affects.
3. Separate confirmed requirements from assumptions. Ask only questions whose answers would change the proposed behavior or scope.
4. Describe the main user workflow, important exceptions, and how users retain control over their information and reminders.
5. Define observable acceptance criteria and identify any privacy, accessibility, or data-retention concerns.
6. Keep implementation choices open unless the repository or user has established them.

## Output

Provide a brief with the user goal, scope, workflow, acceptance criteria, assumptions, and unresolved decisions. Do not create or change files unless asked.
